circumstances: The researcher executes the pre-specified follow-up comparison from Day 7. The run completes, but an unexpected metric discrepancy between the evaluation notebook and the experiment summary prompts a debugging session. After tracing the discrepancy to different binning defaults, the researcher reruns the analysis consistently. The corrected result weakens the apparent subgroup effect, making the main conclusion less dramatic but more stable. The afternoon shifts into manuscript revision and a short collaborator exchange. The replication study remains parked.

activities.title: Run the pre-specified follow-up comparison
activities.summary: The researcher reviewed the bounded experiment specification, checked the configuration, and ran the next pre-specified comparison. The run completed successfully and produced outputs for analysis.
activities.context: Direct continuation of the experiment proposal completed on Day 7.

activities.title: Debug a metric discrepancy and standardize evaluation settings
activities.summary: The experiment summary and notebook reported different calibration values. The researcher traced the discrepancy to inconsistent binning defaults, checked documentation, standardized the metric configuration, and recomputed the relevant runs.
activities.context: The discrepancy affects interpretation of the follow-up experiment.

activities.title: Reanalyze the experiment with consistent metrics
activities.summary: The researcher recomputed the comparison and subgroup intervals using consistent metric settings, then searched for literature on metric sensitivity. The corrected analysis weakens the apparent subgroup difference and makes the overall effect more stable.
activities.context: Uses the corrected evaluation configuration from the debugging session.

activities.title: Revise manuscript interpretation and figures
activities.summary: The researcher revised the results and discussion to remove the stronger subgroup claim, replied to a collaborator with the updated interpretation, and regenerated the shift-comparison figure with clearer labels.
activities.context: Manuscript changes are based on the corrected analysis rather than the initially observed metric discrepancy.

activities.title: Light evening work on citation cleanup
activities.summary: After a short period of music/video browsing, the researcher searched for a citation and updated the bibliography entry. This was useful manuscript maintenance but not a major research advance.
activities.context: Lower-intensity work after the main analysis and writing.

key_observations: The pre-specified follow-up experiment completed, but interpretation initially became uncertain because the notebook and experiment summary used different calibration binning settings.
Tracing the discrepancy to inconsistent metric configuration prevented the researcher from treating an evaluation artifact as a scientific result.
After recomputing the relevant runs consistently, the subgroup effect became weaker while the broader distribution-shift pattern remained more stable.
The manuscript was revised to remove the stronger subgroup interpretation and the collaborator was given the corrected result.
priority_alignment: The main research project remained the clear priority through experiment execution, debugging, analysis, and manuscript revision.
The debugging work was directly relevant because it protected the validity of the current experiment.
The replication study remained parked as previously decided.
important_uncertainty: The corrected results support a more stable overall shift-related effect, but they still do not establish whether the effect generalizes across different shift constructions.
Metric sensitivity has now emerged as an evaluation concern that should be documented explicitly in the manuscript.
expected_reflection.possible_next_step: Freeze the evaluation configuration and record the metric settings in the experiment protocol before running any additional comparison, then decide whether one final generalization test is justified.

primary_action.title: Freeze and document the evaluation protocol
primary_action.reason: The day's main risk came from inconsistent metric settings. Locking the evaluation configuration is necessary before additional experiments can be interpreted reliably.

secondary_action.title: Use the corrected result as the manuscript baseline
secondary_action.reason: The researcher has already revised the interpretation after resolving the discrepancy; future writing should build from the corrected analysis rather than the earlier subgroup claim.

things_not_to_do: Do not use the original notebook values in the manuscript after identifying the binning mismatch.
Do not launch another experiment until the metric configuration is frozen and recorded.
Do not interpret the weaker subgroup effect as evidence that the overall distribution-shift result has disappeared.
